en-US.shortDescription: A stateful Alexa+ kitchen agent that plans meals, tracks pantry state, finds gaps, and drafts a safe cart.
en-US.fullDescription: PantryPilot is a stateful kitchen operations add-on for Alexa+. It remembers pantry inventory and household preferences, generates multi-day meal plans, calculates ingredient shortages, discovers matching products, and prepares a reversible cart draft without placing an order. The service exposes a self-hosted MCP server over Streamable HTTP and keeps household context across sessions. PantryPilot is designed around safe, explainable actions: pantry and preference updates are explicit, shopping gaps are derived from stored inventory, and purchase-related output stops at a cart draft so customers stay in control.
examplePhrases: Ask PantryPilot what I can cook with what is already in my pantry
Ask PantryPilot to plan meals for my household this week
Ask PantryPilot what groceries I am missing
Ask PantryPilot to prepare a draft cart for the missing ingredients
